overrides.reason: Embed-only entry point: chrome profile fixed to embed, no ?url= loading, no autosave/recent/PWA/plugin/dev hooks, Canvas2D only, adds the createBlankDocument, verifyBytes, getPrintPages, getSaveProtection, clearSaveProtection and setDragOver RPC handlers (getSaveProtection and clearSaveProtection tell the shell only whether the document was opened with a password) and forwards dirty-state and edit events to the host. Forwards the shell shortcut combos named in the frame URL (Ctrl+S/O/N/K/W) over the embed port, combo string only. The host owns open/save/new. The 파일 menu items are shell commands forwarded by name over the embed port (src/embed/shell-menu.ts), the shell theme is applied from the frame URL and from the setShellContext RPC. Registers the view:toolbar-labels command (src/ui/toolbar-labels.ts) and applies the stored choice at start, and the table:cell-selection-enter command (src/command/cell-selection.ts) the native 표 menu sends. The shell's edit:undo/redo/cut/copy commands go to a focused dialog text field instead of the document (src/embed/text-field-edit.ts). Adds the enableHostFonts and hostFontsReply RPC handlers: the installed fonts reach the editor's host-font provider through the shell over the embed port (src/embed/host-fonts.ts). Registers the edit:cut command of src/command/safe-cut.ts over the editor's own, which deletes a text selection only after the system clipboard accepted it. Applies the Mac modifier symbols to the static chrome on macOS and suppresses the browser context menu on the menu bar, toolbars and status bar (src/embed/desktop-chrome.ts). Enhances style-bar and dialog select elements with the custom combo box (src/ui/custom-select.ts).
Registers fonts only through FontFace (no injected style element) and only requests the OFL fonts bundled in assets/fonts; CDN and non-shipped catalog entries are never fetched.
Print styles are externalised: static rules in print.css, per-page @page rules in a constructed stylesheet, so no inline style element is created.
Does not advertise plugin-loader-v1 and hwpctrl-v1 (not bundled); adds blank-document-v1, verify-bytes-v1, shell-context-v1, print-pages-v1, save-protection-v1, host-fonts-v1 and drag-over-v1.
Removes the plugin.* RPC methods and adds createBlankDocument, verifyBytes, setShellContext, getPrintPages, getSaveProtection, clearSaveProtection, enableHostFonts, hostFontsReply and setDragOver.

Uses the reference app's custom-select combo boxes and shared color-picker palette (src/ui/custom-select.ts, src/ui/color-picker.ts, src/ui/toolbar-popup.ts) for style, language, font, line-spacing, text color and highlight controls.

assetOverrides.reason: Markup without inline style attributes, relative init scripts and without icon assets; the 보기 menu has the 도구 상자 라벨 표시 check item (view:toolbar-labels); the 파일 menu lists the shell commands (new, open, recent, save, save as, print, close) instead of the editor's own file actions; the underline sample glyph reads 가 instead of 간 (the sample is not translated); loads static/storage-shim.js first, which swaps the storage that an opaque-origin frame cannot reach for memory.
Loading surface with its stylesheet externalised.
